members.note: The only one that also names Mac as a target. The other three say iPhone and iPad.
Description adds battery life, 1-tap Runewords, a Greater Rift, and building it by asking Claude Code or Codex.
Word-for-word the same description as d2r-mobile/d2r-mobile, created the same day. No language detected by GitHub at snapshot.
Same wording as jhaizhou-ops but drops Mac. No language detected by GitHub at snapshot.

families.note: All four were created on 12 Oct 2026 under MIT and all describe running your own Switch copy of Diablo II: Resurrected on Apple devices. The snapshot does not say which is upstream. Use "Check live" to ask GitHub whether any of them is a registered fork.

revisions.summary: First note, written from the four repo descriptions.

families.name: nvidia-macos-driver

members.note: The driver itself. Targets macOS Sequoia.
Its homepage points at nullmoth. Adds Tahoe (macOS 26) icon and NVAccel fixes plus the backup fix from upstream PR #59.
Not a fork. A Rust CLI that installs the NullMoth driver and repairs OpenCore config for Turing cards.

families.note: Pick nullmoth for the driver. The WhySooooFurious copy is the place to look for Tahoe support; the joseteo tool sits on top of either.

revisions.summary: First note, written from the three repo descriptions and the downstream homepage link.
